g.text: $ python ask.py ask --box ofrenda --url http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1 --model gemma-3-4b-it --system voices/femia.md
"why does the old computer beep at midnight on november 2"
[1] Bueno, it's supposed to be. Joaquín showed me cron and told the computer to beep at midnight on November 2 and
say “prendan la vela,” so they remember to light the candle for me when I am gone.
